verdict.rationale: Groq is driven through a documented public REST API. It offers an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.groq.com/openai/v1, Chat Completions and Responses APIs, a Batch API, tool use, structured outputs, and an official TypeScript SDK for the REST API. Community users also report using the API directly. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To start using Groq with OpenAI's client libraries, pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Generating text with Groq's Chat Completions API enables you to have natural, conversational interactions with Groq's large language models.
Process large-scale workloads asynchronously with our Batch API
